generator_invariants.locals: fresh lowercase safe identifiers; each bound exactly once by := and every use dominated by its binding
generator_invariants.references: static dot paths only; root must be input or data; at least one field segment
generator_invariants.input_data_domain: finite JSON objects with string-safe keys and string/boolean/null leaves; no arrays or sets

case_record.seed_rule: persist the generator seed before route execution; deterministic fixtures use seed=null and fixture_id instead

common: AST contains only the frozen grammar constructs
bind-before-use and single-assignment local invariant holds
all refs are static dot paths rooted at input or data
all values remain in the frozen scalar/object domain
opa_topdown: evaluate data.fuzz.r with Rego v1 under the frozen input/data
persist OPA version or commit and raw result
opa_wasm_exact: compile the same frozen source to Wasm for entrypoint fuzz/r
extract and persist SHA-256 of the emitted policy.wasm bytes
load those exact bytes into a pinned OPA-Wasm-compatible runtime/SDK
set the same frozen data and evaluate the same frozen input
persist compiler identity, Wasm digest, runtime identity and raw result
no unsupported host builtin is reachable; Tier-0 has no builtins
regorus_interpreter: same policy/data/input/entrypoint as all other routes
persist Regorus version or commit and raw Value
regorus_rvm: compile the same policy with the same entrypoint
round-trip serialize the Program before execution
persist Regorus version or commit plus serialized Program digest and raw Value

canonical_outcome_projection.DEFINED: successful defined value; Tier-0 canonical values are exact string/boolean/null
canonical_outcome_projection.UNDEFINED: route-specific absence of a decision/value, e.g. zero OPA result assignments or Regorus Value::Undefined
canonical_outcome_projection.ERROR: parse/compile/evaluation/runtime failure mapped to a versioned error class while retaining raw diagnostics
canonical_outcome_projection.UNSUPPORTED: may be emitted only by the frozen pre-outcome support predicate; a runtime failure may never be relabeled unsupported after observing the result

comparison_rule: Compare canonical outcomes only after all participating routes passed their frozen pre-outcome support predicates. Preserve every raw output and route/artifact identity.

initial_allowed_operations: delete a trailing statement only when dependency closure remains valid
replace a reference leaf with a frozen scalar
shorten a static path only when the shortened path remains supported
shrinker_invariants.invalid_minimization: Any shrink that crosses out of the frozen support predicate is not a valid minimized witness.

evidence_scope: This file freezes the generator/oracle specification before generated outcomes. It is not evidence that any route pair agrees.
